items.headline: Texas State and Utah State meet in Pac-12 action

items.headline: Utah State scores 14 unanswered points after halftime to beat Washington State 17-16
items.description: — Grady Brosterhous threw for 150 yards and a touchdown, Javen Jacobs had 62 yards rushing and a score, and Utah State scored 14 unanswered points in the second half to beat Washington State 17-16 on Friday night.

items.headline: Utah State hosts Washington State in Pac-12 action
items.description: Washington State (1-4) at Utah State (1-4), Oct. 9 at 9 p.m. EDT.

items.headline: Madsen, No. 22 Boise State beat Utah State 37-18 in the teams' inaugural Pac-12 game
items.description: — Maddux Madsen was 17-of-21 passing for 244 yards and two touchdowns, Dylan Riley added two rushing touchdowns and No. 22 Boise State beat Utah State 37-18 on Saturday in the inaugural game as a member of the Pac-12 Conference for both teams.
